outcome: Severe disease requiring invasive mechanical ventilation (IMV)
cohort: The study included all neonates (<28 days old) admitted with pneumonia between January and December 2024 in rural Vietnam.
finding: The primary finding identifies younger age, neurological symptoms, and elevated C-reactive protein (CRP ≥10 mg/L) as independent risk factors for requiring invasive mechanical ventilation (IMV) in neonates with pneumonia.
